title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
abstract: arXiv:2610.22340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can robots autonomously collect the contact-rich experience needed to learn dexterous manipulation? We present DSP: Dexterity from supervised play, a framework in which a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play through behavior cloning, then deploys it autonomously to collect hours of interaction data to train a world model. During inference, the same play policy then guides model-predictive control (MPC) by proposing candidate action sequences for evaluation under the learned world model. To accelerate inference, we also introduce a method for distilling a closed-loop, goal-conditioned policy through self-play within the learned world model. We evaluate this framework on underactuated pushing and any-to-any in-hand pose reorientation with a multifingered hand, in simulation and real world. translated_title: 从有监督玩耍中习得灵巧操作
translated_abstract: 机器人如何自主收集学习灵巧操作所需的丰富接触经验？我们提出了DSP（Dexterity from Supervised Play，从有监督玩耍中习得灵巧）框架：机器人通过行为克隆从几分钟的人类玩耍数据中学习一个玩耍策略，随后自主部署该策略，收集数小时的交互数据来训练一个世界模型。在推理阶段，同一玩耍策略通过提出候选动作序列并交由学习到的世界模型评估，来引导模型预测控制（MPC）。为加速推理，我们还提出一种方法，在学到的世界模型内部通过自我博弈（self-play）蒸馏出一个闭环的、目标条件策略。我们在仿真和真实世界中，针对欠驱动推物任务和多指手的任意到任意手中姿态重定向任务对该框架进行了评估。在真实世界实验中，我们的方法在成功率上比事后行为克隆（hindsight behavior cloning）高出69.6%，并取得了可比的成功率表现。
tldr: 该论文提出DSP框架：机器人先通过行为克隆从几分钟人类玩耍数据中学到玩耍策略，再自主部署收集数小时交互数据训练世界模型，随后用该世界模型引导模型预测控制，并通过世界模型内的自我博弈蒸馏出闭环目标条件策略，在真实世界灵巧操作任务中成功率比事后行为克隆高出69.6%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DSP, a framework where a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play via behavior cloning, autonomously deploys it to collect hours of interaction data for training a world model, then uses this world model to guide MPC and distills a closed-loop goal-conditioned policy through self-play, outperforming hindsight behavior cloning by 69.6% in real-world dexterous manipulation success rate.
